prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your desktop companion is officially ready to join your workspace!"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick guide on managing your pet directly on your desktop screen.", "Drag to move pet anywhere | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk", "Got It"]
2: ["Tips for Custom Pet Generation", "Use clear, well-lit photos with a centered subject for best results.", "Continue to Upload"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Let us guide you through creating your custom desktop buddy.", "Start Setup"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Linking your account secures your pet state and custom settings permanently.", "Please use your primary email to ensure pet data syncs seamlessly."]
5: ["Spawning Pet on Desktop...", "We are placing your companion onto your desktop environment.", "If pet is hidden behind windows, check your system tray icon to show it."]
6: ["Don't worry! You can change pet accessories and behaviors anytime from settings.", "Popular Friend"]
7: ["Select Your Adoption Method", "Choose a classic pre-designed friend or create a custom pet from photos."]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "Look at your screen corner to meet your new pet.", "Pet process active in system tray"]
9: ["Quick Account Connection", "Sign in to keep your pet save file safe."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information by requesting the user's primary email address.
